statement: The scale-certification and comparative-efficiency planning surfaces define one scale-owned terminal-receipt freshness prerequisite, link it only to claim projection, preserve P0 measurement parallelism, and draft the implementation Quest without asserting measured or certified results.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
This Quest changes only planning, specification, and draft Quest contracts; it must not claim that comparative performance, cost, or scale certification was measured.
Receipt schema, exact certification tuple, and freshness remain owned by scale certification; comparative claim projection consumes the owner decision without forking it.
The new prerequisite gates only claim projection, not P0 workload measurement, and P0 remains eligible only for measured_p0.
